verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs repeatedly state access to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools through its hosted MCP server, with a dedicated MCP server per app. A probe of llms.txt independently confirms the catalog spans 3,223 apps. Per-app pages such as ClickUp and OpenAI (46 actions, 4 triggers) and a proxy fallback for endpoints without pre-built tools show the catalog has real depth. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of catalog quality and breadth beyond vendor-controlled pages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform

citations.quote: Add Pipedream MCP to your app or agent to make tool calls on behalf of your users to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools.
Each app has its own dedicated MCP server with tools specific to that API.
Pipedream Connect provides managed auth, MCP servers, and API tooling for 3,223
For a ClickUp endpoint with no pre-built tool, the proxy forwards your request with the connected user's credentials attached.
